It is no certification, no confirmation of conformity by a third party and no legal advice. Warranty and liability: DISCLAIMER.md applies, to the maximum extent permitted by law. The operator stays responsible for the conformity of their organisation. Anyone can have this information verified independently at any time by auditors of their own choice, with: the SHA-256 of this file in the signed SHA256SUMS of the release, "efactl compliance-verify" on an installed host, and the open source code (AGPL-3.0).

standards.title: GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
standards.applies: Always for an operator in the EU or for mail of people in the EU. The operator is the controller.

controls.title: Data minimisation
controls.scope: No mail content in logs; subjects only for permitted roles; pseudonyms in the mail log; header privacy outbound.
controls.limits: Pseudonyms after 14 days only on new installs; an upgrade keeps the old setting.

controls.title: Storage limitation
controls.scope: Retention days per kind of data and tenant, nightly purge with an audit entry.
controls.limits: Backups keep data up to their own age.

controls.title: Right of access
controls.scope: gdpr-export of everything about one mail address.
controls.limits: Accounts and sender lists are named, not exported in full.

controls.title: Right to erasure
controls.scope: gdpr-delete of one mail address: mail log rows, stored headers, held mail, spam reports and mail relations; when asked its accounts and its entries of the sender lists. Audited with a pseudonym and the reason; every erasure goes into an erasure list (pseudonyms only, outside the backups) that a restore applies again.
controls.limits: Backups stay as they are (signed) for up to 5 days; logs of the operating system and mail already delivered to the mailbox are outside eFa-next.

controls.title: Data protection by design and by default
controls.scope: New features are off after an update; private defaults on new installs.
controls.limits: Defaults of an upgraded host stay as they were.

controls.title: Processor
controls.scope: A template for the data processing agreement; tenants separated in rights.
controls.limits: The template is not reviewed by a lawyer; the contract is the operator's.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.scope: privacy-evidence builds the record of processing and the TOM from the settings in effect.
controls.limits: The record stays the operator's document.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.scope: TLS profiles, 2FA and passkeys, login lockout, signed and encrypted backups, audit chain with signed anchors, SELinux and service sandboxes.
controls.limits: Mail log, queue and database are not encrypted at rest by eFa-next: disk encryption is the operator's.

evidence.ref: Incoming SMTP offers TLS 1.2 or newer only
The strict audit log has a valid signed anchor of the last two days

controls.title: Notification of a personal data breach
controls.scope: Audit log, events to SIEM and Wazuh, the NIS2 report helper for the timeline; reports for NIS2, GDPR Art. 33 and DORA Art. 19 prepared from the incident record, and an incident response template.
controls.limits: The notice itself is the operator's.

controls.title: Data protection impact assessment
controls.scope: A template of the impact assessment for mail filtering; privacy-evidence fills the technical part.
controls.limits: Template not checked by a lawyer; the assessment is the operator's.

controls.title: Transfers to third countries
controls.scope: EU link: backups only to EU-owned providers, report services outside the EU only after a typed confirmation, no ruf.
controls.limits: Only with the EU link answered yes; a host can opt out with a typed confirmation.

standards.title: Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847), Annex I
standards.applies: Essential requirements of a product with digital elements; for eFa-next as open source software.

controls.title: Secure by default configuration
controls.scope: Fail-closed defaults, TLS limits, no plain SIEM, new features off after updates.
controls.limits: Port 25 stays opportunistic (RFC 3207) by design.

evidence.ref: Incoming SMTP offers TLS 1.2 or newer only

controls.title: Security updates, automatic where possible

controls.title: Protection from unauthorised access

controls.limits: 2FA is optional until a role or framework requires it.

controls.title: Confidentiality of data

evidence.ref: The web interface offers TLS 1.2 or newer only
The file systems of the mail data are encrypted (LUKS)

controls.title: Integrity of data and configuration
controls.scope: Signed backups, audit chain, security floor guard, rpm -V, file integrity through Wazuh; file check of the configuration without Wazuh (fim-set).
controls.limits: File integrity alerts need the Wazuh agent.

evidence.ref: The strict audit log has a valid signed anchor of the last two days

controls.scope: File check of eFa-next (fim-set): a signed baseline of /etc/eFa, /etc/postfix, /etc/rspamd/local.d and /etc/nginx, compared before every change through efactl and hashed again daily; changes outside efactl raise an event and a Wazuh alert until an admin accepts them. Also file integrity through Wazuh; rpm -V; security floor guard.
